review.title: Stop counting pending deliveries as failures
review.context: The routing summary counted every non-delivered record as failed, including pending operations. Count delivered, failed and pending separately so the summary reflects their actual states.
review.invariant: Total equals delivered plus failed plus pending. Pending-only input reports zero failures. Total attempts remains the sum of recorded attempts. Delivery ownership and retry behaviour remain unchanged.
review.notes: Bob implemented the status-counting fix and regression tests. The before/after comparison shows the original formula returning one failure for a pending-only record and the corrected function returning zero. No current application caller uses this summary; downstream benefits remain unmeasured.
